name: Fort Meade
tagline: The home of the NSA and U.S. Cyber Command, the nation's signals-intelligence and cyber hub, between Baltimore and D.C.
_note: Army intel/cyber post (Anne Arundel County, between Baltimore and DC). Facts verified from official sources (home.army.mil/meade, kimbrough.tricare.mil, Corvias, DeCA/AAFES, Wikipedia for corroborated headline facts). BAH MHA MD133 (Fort G. G. Meade) via the bah_rates single source of truth. Housing operated by Corvias. Maryland is TRICARE East. Medium-confidence flags: base coords (approx), representative off-base ZIP 21113 (Odenton). Rechecked 2026-11-10 (research/meade-facts.md): Army Cyber Command HQ left for Fort Gordon in 2020 (780th MI Brigade stays); no posted on-post wait; only Reece Road open 24/7 since July 2025; FY2027 county tax rates; Maryland plate law October 1, 2026; Kimbrough has no ER.

sections.title: Mission & Identity
data: Fort Meade is best known as the home of the National Security Agency and U.S. Cyber Command, making it the center of the nation's signals-intelligence and cyber missions. It also hosts the Defense Information Systems Agency, the 780th Military Intelligence Brigade (Cyber), the Defense Information School and more than 120 partner agencies in all; Army Cyber Command's headquarters moved to Fort Gordon in 2020.

It sits in Anne Arundel County, midway between Baltimore and Washington, D.C., so it functions as a sprawling intelligence and cyber campus rather than an operational post, with a large civilian and joint workforce.

source.label: Fort Meade home page (official, November 2026); Army.mil (July 1, 2020)

sections.title: Between Baltimore and D.C.: Where to Live

data.subtitle: Meade's location between two major cities gives you lots of options and a high cost of living. Where you live trades commute against price and schools across the Baltimore-Washington corridor.
intro: Maryland doesn't tax the military pay of a member whose legal residence is another state, so for those families the county choice comes down to property tax, schools, prices and the drive. Fiscal 2027 property tax, county plus state, is $1.080 per $100 of assessed value in Anne Arundel outside incorporated cities, $1.112 in Prince George's outside its cities ($1.570 in Bowie, $1.689 in Laurel) and $1.362 in Howard. Through the Homestead Tax Credit, Anne Arundel caps yearly increases in the taxable assessment of a principal residence at 2%, against 3% in Prince George's and 5% in Howard.

Median sale prices from April to June 2026 were $520,000 in Anne Arundel, $650,000 in Howard and $471,388 in Prince George's (Maryland SDAT). Laurel and Jessup addresses cross county lines, so check the county on Maryland's property search before you compare.

recommendations.advice: Severn is about 10 minutes from the Kimbrough clinic on post and Odenton about 16 with no traffic. Only the Reece Road Gate is open around the clock.
Howard County (Columbia, about 25 minutes) had a 91.3% graduation rate for the class of 2025, against 88.9% in Anne Arundel and 86.4% statewide, but its median sale price is about $130,000 higher.
Corvias runs 2,628 homes in six communities. No official wait time is posted, so ask Corvias when you have orders.
MARC's Penn Line stops at Odenton and the Camden Line at Jessup, Savage and Laurel, for jobs and weekends in Baltimore and Washington.

source.label: Maryland SDAT (FY2027 tax rates and Homestead caps; April to June 2026 sales); HCPSS and AACPS (January 2026)

sections.title: Gates & Access
data: After gate hours were cut in July 2025, only the Reece Road Gate is open 24 hours, every day. The Mapes/32 and Rockenbach Road gates open weekdays 5:30 a.m. to 6 p.m., and Mapes/175 weekdays 6 to 9 a.m. (both ways) and 3 to 6 p.m. (outbound only); all three close on weekends.

Visitors use the Visitor Control Center, weekdays 7 a.m. to noon and 1 to 4 p.m. (301-677-1389), or the Reece Road visitor lane when it is closed. Unescorted visitors need a REAL ID or an acceptable alternative ID; digital licenses aren't accepted. Hours change, so confirm on the official site before you go.

source.label: Fort Meade installation access and visitor information (official, September 2026)

sections.title: On-Base Housing
data: On-post family housing is privatized and operated by Corvias: 2,628 homes in six communities (Midway Common, Meuse Forest, Patriot Ridge, Potomac Place, Heritage Park and Normandy Bluffs), plus Reece Crossings apartments on post for single service members.

No official wait time is posted; Military OneSource says waits vary and to ask Corvias directly. Members assigned to Fort Meade get priority. Army Housing Services Office: 3081 Ernie Pyle Street, 301-677-7748, weekdays 8 a.m. to 4 p.m.

source.label: Military OneSource, Fort Meade government housing
DoD 2026 BAH Rates, MHA MD133 (Fort G. G. Meade)

sections.title: Schools
data: There are no DoD schools at Fort Meade; children attend local public schools. On post, Anne Arundel County Public Schools runs three elementary schools, two middle schools, Meade High School and an early education center.

In the 2026 Maryland Report Card, Manor View and Pershing Hill elementary earned 4 of 5 stars, and Meade Heights elementary, MacArthur and Meade middle schools and Meade High 3 stars. Class of 2025 graduation: Howard County 91.3%, Anne Arundel 88.9%, Meade High 82.5%, state 86.4%. Your address sets the school, so confirm it. School Liaison: 301-677-1227.

source.label: Fort Meade schools page (official); Maryland Report Card (2026)

data.Care: Outpatient care on post; no emergency room (dial 911). Kimbrough's list of nearby emergency rooms includes University of Maryland Baltimore Washington Medical Center (Glen Burnie) and Johns Hopkins Howard County Medical Center (Columbia); its military options include Walter Reed (Bethesda) and A.T. Augusta (Fort Belvoir).

source.label: Kimbrough Ambulatory Care Center, emergency medicine (official)

intro: Whether to rent or buy is the biggest money decision of most PCS moves, and at Meade the long, often civilian-heavy tours lead many families to buy, despite the high cost of living.
rent: Your tour is short or your orders feel uncertain.
You want time to learn the corridor before committing to a neighborhood.
You'd rather not gamble on resale timing or carry a high payment.
On-base or off-base renting keeps your housing costs predictable.
buy: You expect to be here three or more years, which is common at Meade.
You want to use your VA loan in a strong, stable corridor market.
You could rent the home out later given steady regional demand.
You've found a home and commute you're confident about.
data.bottom_line: There is no universal right answer. The Baltimore-Washington corridor is expensive but stable, BAH is high, and tours run long, which favors buying for many. Run your BAH against the rent and home prices above, weigh your tour length, and talk to a lender and an agent who work with military families before you commit.

intro: The first month at a new duty station is mostly logistics. Knocking these out early makes everything else easier.

steps.title: Line up temporary lodging
steps.text: Book on-base lodging or a short-term rental before you arrive. You can claim Temporary Lodging Expense (TLE) for a limited number of days while you house-hunt.

steps.title: In-process and update DEERS
steps.text: Report to your unit and finance, and make sure DEERS and ID cards are current for every family member so TRICARE and base access work.

steps.title: Start with the Housing Office
steps.text: Check on-base availability with Corvias and get the housing office's read on the counties before you sign anything.

steps.title: Sort your vehicle and base access
steps.text: Maryland has no yearly car tax. If your legal residence is another state, you can keep your home-state registration and apply for the MVA's free military nonresident permit; since October 1, 2026 the MVA can notify residents with out-of-state plates and fine them if they don't act within 60 days. Active-duty members don't pay the 6.5% titling tax on a car already titled in their name.

steps.title: Enroll the kids in school
steps.text: Contact Anne Arundel County (or Howard County) schools early and bring records and immunizations.

steps.title: Set up healthcare
steps.text: Update your TRICARE enrollment so you can be seen at Kimbrough Ambulatory Care Center or network providers.

data.a: It's the home of the National Security Agency and U.S. Cyber Command, plus the Defense Information Systems Agency, the 780th Military Intelligence Brigade (Cyber) and more than 120 partner agencies, with more than 64,000 employees.

Severn (about 10 minutes from the Kimbrough clinic) and Odenton (about 16) are close; Howard County (Columbia, about 25) has the highest graduation rate but higher prices. On-post housing is Corvias, with no official wait time posted.

Yes. Median sale prices from April to June 2026 were $520,000 in Anne Arundel and $650,000 in Howard (Maryland SDAT), and property tax differs by county: $1.080 per $100 in Anne Arundel against $1.362 in Howard (FY2027).
Fort Meade is MHA MD133. Use the calculator above for your grade.

data.q: Does Maryland tax my military pay?
data.a: Not if your legal residence is another state. If Maryland is your legal residence, your military pay is taxed, plus a county rate (2026: 2.70% to 3.20% in Anne Arundel, 3.20% in Howard and Prince George's).
